notes: 0.7.0: Adds the staged-progress trait (planned/in_progress/done/withdrawn/superseded, depends_on) plus task and phase patterns. Adds an outbound contradicts relationship on epistemic-claim and a new contradictable trait (contradicted_by) composed into the decision pattern only.
0.6.0: Capability families removed. Projects declare records, views, and bundles. source_lock covers catalog, traits, and backends only. Pattern set adds observation; event includes evidence-linked.
0.6.0 experimental: unpublished; not a released catalog. Version is an internal iteration, not a published language.
